description: Saves the Practice setup form's answers as PracticeManager/Practices/<slug>.json in Knowledge (org scope), matching a Xero organisation name to its tenant id the same way Bookkeeping for Xero does. This is the only path that can create or update a practice's settings file - the Practice Manager Agent itself can only read it.
